SSO base and rates, provident fund, declared tax deductions and the monthly withholding are the accountant's basis for payroll. Statutory values are defaults, editable per row; history is never rewritten when the law changes. Amounts are masked until the password is re-entered; every view is logged.

ui.pmg_VFD_1: Heatsink and air path cleaned｜no dust build-up, air path clear
ui.pmg_VFD_2: Cooling fans｜run smoothly, no bearing noise
ui.pmg_VFD_3: DC-link capacitors｜no bulging or leaks, capacitance / ripple within limits
ui.pmg_VFD_4: Terminals and busbars｜re-torqued, no heat discolouration
ui.pmg_VFD_5: Supply voltage and phase balance｜380 V ±10 %, imbalance < 3 %
ui.pmg_VFD_6: Cabinet temperature and environment｜≤ 40 °C, no condensation or corrosion
ui.pmg_VFD_7: Fault and alarm log｜exported and reviewed, no repeating faults
ui.pmg_VFD_8: Parameter backup｜saved and its reference recorded
ui.pmg_MOTOR_2: Bearing temperature and vibration｜within limits, no noise
ui.pmg_MOTOR_4: Terminal box connections｜tight, no heat marks
ui.pmg_MOTOR_5: Cooling fan and air path｜clean, not blocked
ui.pmg_MOTOR_6: Encoder and signal cable｜secure, signal healthy
ui.pmg_PANEL_1: Inside of cabinet cleaned｜no dust or debris
ui.pmg_PANEL_3: Cabinet fans and filters｜running, filters clean or replaced
ui.pmg_PANEL_4: Protection and emergency-stop circuits｜function test passed
ui.pmg_PANEL_6: Thermal image (if available)｜no abnormal hot spots
ui.pmg_PLC_2: Memory backup battery｜voltage OK or replaced on schedule
ui.pmg_PLC_4: Communication｜no drop-outs or growing error counts
ui.pmg_PLC_5: I/O terminals and 24 V supply｜tight, voltage within range
